EC1: Lifetime history of Bipolar Disorder [OR], Dementia [OR], Autism Spectrum Disorder [OR], Schizophrenia [OR], or any other Psychotic Disorder.
EC2: Psychotic symptoms occurring at any time during the current major depressive episode [AND].
EC3: Current (past 12 months) diagnosis of Panic disorder [OR], Obsessive Compulsive Disorder [OR], Posttraumatic Stress Disorder [OR], Anorexia Nervosa [OR], or Bulimia Nervosa.
EC4: Alcohol [OR] or Drug Dependence within 12 months or Abuse within 3 months (excluding nicotine [OR] and caffeine) of baseline visit, as assessed by history and urine drug screen.
EC5: Clinical evidence of a severe Personality Disorder, as assessed by the study psychiatrist, which would impede participation or completion of the trial.
EC6: Known neurological disorders [OR] or documented serious head injury.
EC7: Serious and unstable medical illnesses including cardiovascular disease [OR] and cancer.
EC8: Active medical conditions with known mood changes (endocrine [OR], autoimmune disorders).
EC10: For women, pregnancy, lactation, or unwillingness to comply with birth control requirements.
EC11: Use of any of the following treatments [OR] or any other alternative therapy [AND] within 2 weeks of the pre-treatment PET scan that may have beneficial effects on mood, including St John's Wort [OR], S-adenosyl methionine [OR] (SAMe), n-3 fatty acids [OR], or light therapy.
EC12: Use of antidepressant medication within 1 month of the pre-treatment PET scan (within 5 weeks for fluoxetine and protryptyline).
EC13: Failure to achieve a much improved status (i.e. equivalent to >50% symptom reduction) with any lifetime treatment course of CBT (defined as a minimum of 4 sessions of a specified manual-driven therapy by a CBT-trained therapist) or escitalopram (defined as a minimum of 6 weeks of at least 10 mg/day).
EC14: Clinically significant active suicidal ideation [OR] or self-injurious behavior [AND] necessitating immediate treatment, as determined by the investigator.
EC15: Received electroconvulsive therapy in the past 6 months [OR] or during the current depressive episode.
EC16: Currently responding to medication treatment, without clinical reasons to change.
EC17: Current treatment with weekly individual [OR] or group psychotherapy [AND] of any type targeted at depressive symptoms.
EC18: QTc [AND] >500 milliseconds on EKG at screening.
EC19: Contraindications [AND] for MRI, including, but [NOT] not limited to pacemaker [OR], aneurysm clips [OR], neurostimulators [OR], cochlear implants [OR], metal [OR] in eyes, steel worker [OR], intra-uterine devices for birth control.
EC20: Maintenance or prophylactic therapy for stable medical conditions.
EC21: [NOT] [NOT] Hypnotic medication prescribed or approved by the study physician, (up to a three doses per week) for insomnia, as long if not the night before a PET/MRI [OR] or clinic ratings visit. Antipsychotic medications, whether prescribed for sleep or other indications, are prohibited.
